text: ぼくらの　ひそひそ　ばなしを　ぬすみ　ぎき　してた　やつだ！

structure.jp: ぼくらの　ひそひそ　ばなしを
ぬすみ　ぎき　してた　やつだ！
structure.en: it's the guy who was eavesdropping on it!

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ぬすみ　ぎき　してた　やつ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a word describes that word. ぬすみ　ぎき　してた　やつ = 'the guy who was eavesdropping'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てた is the casual short form of ていた, which shows something was going on for a while in the past. してた = 'was doing'.
